name: v199_invested_capital_turnover
hypothesis: Firms that generate more sales and gross profit per unit of invested capital, while invested capital is not expanding, may be using capital more efficiently. This avoids inventory/receivable/backlog working-capital routes and the new goodwill/total-assets contraction ACTIVE.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_newqv1300_icaptq / assets, 126), industry) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.060 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: First direct invested-capital efficiency test. Strict-check against e7OW7dL6, MPpGzqwr, RRpm5LEo, and old working-capital failures.

name: v199_quarterly_icapt_discipline
hypothesis: Quarterly invested-capital restraint should be more responsive than annual invested capital. Pair it with gross-profit efficiency to test whether capital productivity carries information without total-assets analyst fields.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newqv1300_icaptq / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newqv1300_icaptq), 126), subindustry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / abs(fnd6_newqv1300_icaptq), 126), subindustry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_newa2v1300_wcap / assets, 126), industry) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.060 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Uses quarterly invested capital and only a broad working-capital level sleeve; no inventory, receivable, or backlog terms.

name: v199_event_icapt_no_overhang
hypothesis: Event-vector invested capital reductions may capture discrete capital-allocation cleanups. Convert the vector with vec_avg and confirm with low annual invested-capital burden rather than debt, issuance, or goodwill.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.42, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_icaptq)) / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_icaptq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_newqv1300_wcapq / assets, 126), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.060 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: A unit-safe event-vector test. Reject on weak metrics or LSUS; do not repair with debt/issuance/social/news sleeves.

name: v199_working_capital_assetlight
hypothesis: Lower working-capital burden can be useful only if paired with sales and gross-profit productivity, not inventory/receivable cycle terms. This tests a cleaner asset-light operating-capital signal.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.50, 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fnd6_newa2v1300_wcap / assets, 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newa2v1300_wcap / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / abs(fnd6_newa2v1300_wcap), 126), subindustry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newa2v1300_wcap), 126), subindustry) + 0.090 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.060 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Working-capital burden without inventory turnover, receivables, deferred revenue, or backlog. Stop if it repeats early working-capital weakness.

name: v199_icapt_margin_subindustry
hypothesis: Capital efficiency should be judged locally. Subindustry ranks for gross-profit and sales productivity, plus industry rank for invested-capital contraction, may reduce old broad quality overlap.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.48, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_newa1v1300_gp / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(sales / abs(fnd6_newa1v1300_icapt), 126), subindustry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(fnd6_newqv1300_icaptq / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_wcapq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.080 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry) + 0.060 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Local peer version. Avoids analyst total-assets and goodwill terms; strict corr check with e7OW7dL6 is mandatory.
